title: 72 Hour Survival Checklist
description: Item-by-item checklists built on the Ready.gov basic kit: water at 1 gallon per person per day, food, medications, light and power, first aid, documents, tools, and sanitation, with urban and rural add-ons. Covers kids, older adults and people with disabilities, pets, generator safety, a go-bag pack list, and a maintenance routine.
shortDescription: Ready.gov kit: 1 gallon of water per person per day, food, meds, power, papers
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
